/* Skill card. Position comes inline from Module:Skill. Same look as the Mount / Glider / item cards. */
/* A skill can have versions (Basic, Quake, Lightning ... shown at the top right) and a chain (Triple Slash).
   .aa-skill-set holds one container per version (.aa-varset-v<n>), each with one card per skill of its chain
   (.aa-card-k<k>). The requested card is .aa-skill-main in the container .aa-varmain, that is what is shown first.
   In front of the containers sits an anchor for every card (.aa-pick-v<n>.aa-pick-k<k>): the :target of the links
   of the version names and of the chain icons. The anchor is position: fixed, so the browser does not scroll the
   page when it is the target. The cards of a chain lie on top of each other in one grid cell (the hidden ones
   are only invisible), so a chain is as tall as its tallest card and the page does not jump when another skill
   is shown. The shown card is stretched to that height and keeps its Chain row at the bottom. A version has
   its own size. */
.aa-skill-set {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: start;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.aa-skill-anchor {
  position: fixed;
  display: block;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-varset {
  display: none;
  justify-items: start;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.aa-varset.aa-varmain {
  display: grid;
}
.aa-skill-set > .aa-pick:target ~ .aa-varmain {
  display: none;
}
.aa-varset > .aa-skill {
  grid-area: 1 / 1;
  visibility: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.aa-varset > .aa-skill-main {
  visibility: visible;
}
.aa-skill-set > .aa-pick:target ~ .aa-varset > .aa-skill-main {
  visibility: hidden;
}
/* one rule per version and per chain position (up to 6 versions and 10 skills in a chain) */
.aa-skill-set > .aa-pick-v1:target ~ .aa-varset-v1 {
  display: grid;

/* empty space where another skill of the chain has "Effect Granted" (same height as the real thing) */
.aa-skill-reserve {
  visibility: hidden;
}
/* shown in the kept space of a skill without effects, when another skill of its chain has some */
.aa-skill-noeffects {
  color: #6f6a5e;
  font-style: italic;
}
.aa-skill-buffspace {
  height: 34px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
/* the free space of a stretched card goes above the Chain row, which sits at the bottom of the card */
.aa-skill-chainbox {
  margin-top: auto;
}
/* margins of a column do not collapse: the header's bottom margin and the line's top margin would add up */
.aa-varset > .aa-skill .aa-skill-head {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.aa-skill {
  display: flow-root;
  position: relative;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 320px;
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  margin: 0 0 0.5em 0;
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-size: 13px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: left;
}
.aa-skill-head {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.aa-skill-icon {
  line-height: 0;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-title {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
/* skill line (Songcraft ...) in the orange of the game */
.aa-skill-line {
  color: #ff9c27;
}
.aa-skill-name {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #ffffff;
}
.aa-skill-sep {
  height: 1px;
  margin: 6px 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #6a5d48, transparent);
}
.aa-skill-meta {
  color: #c9c3b4;
}
.aa-skill-buffs {
  margin-top: 4px;
  line-height: 0;
}
/* green frame around the icon of an effect; hovering it opens a box with the effect */
.aa-skill-buff {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  line-height: 0;
  cursor: help;
  outline: none;
  border: 1px solid #4ec24e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(78, 194, 78, 0.6);
}
.aa-skill-bufftip {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 100%;
  z-index: 1000;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 260px;
  margin-top: 4px;
  padding: 7px 9px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.98), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.98));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  color: #d8d2c4;
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  text-align: left;
  white-space: normal;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.aa-skill-right .aa-skill-bufftip {
  left: auto;
  right: 0;
}
.aa-skill-buff:hover .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-buff:focus .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-req:hover .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-req:focus .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-applier:hover .aa-skill-bufftip,
.aa-skill-applier:focus .aa-skill-bufftip {
  display: block;
}
/* an effect that needs a passive skill: always visible under the icons */
.aa-skill-req {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 5px;
  color: #ff9c27;
  cursor: help;
  outline: none;
}
.aa-skill-req img {
  display: block;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-reqnote {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  color: #ff9c27;
}
/* the icon of a combo's condition: hovering it lists the skills that apply the effect */
.aa-skill-applier {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  cursor: help;
  outline: none;
}
.aa-skill-applier .aa-skill-bufftip {
  top: auto;
  bottom: 100%;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.aa-skill-applysub.aa-skill-applynote {
  color: #b9b09a;
  font-style: italic;
}
.aa-skill-applyrow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.aa-skill-applyrow img {
  display: block;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-applyrow .aa-skill-applyitem img {
  border: 0;
}
.aa-skill-applyneed,
.aa-skill-applyicon {
  flex: none;
  line-height: 0;
}
.aa-skill-applyneed img {
  display: block;
  border: 1px solid #d9423a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(217, 66, 58, 0.7);
}
.aa-skill-applygap,
.aa-skill-applygap img {
  visibility: hidden;
  border-color: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.aa-skill-applytitle + .aa-skill-applyrow {
  margin-top: 0;
}
.aa-skill-applyrow + .aa-skill-applytitle {
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.aa-skill-applysub {
  display: block;
  margin: 0 0 2px 26px;
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.aa-skill-applyname {
  color: #e8e4d8;
}
.aa-skill-applyline {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #a8a396;
  font-size: 11px;
}
/* duration, ticks, stacks in the box of an effect */
.aa-skill-fact {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 3px;
  color: #a8a396;
}
.aa-skill-bufftext + .aa-skill-fact {
  margin-top: 5px;
}
.aa-skill-buffname {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-skill-bufftext .aa-item-gap {
  margin-top: 0.5em;
}
/* red frame for a harmful effect (debuff) */
.aa-skill-debuff {
  border-color: #d9423a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(217, 66, 58, 0.7);
}
.aa-skill-desc {
  color: #e8e4d8;
}
.aa-skill-gap,
.aa-skill-desc .aa-item-gap {
  margin-top: 0.7em;
}

/* element (Quake, Life ...) and rank at the right of the header */
.aa-skill-tag {
  margin-left: auto;
  align-self: flex-start;
  text-align: right;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.aa-skill-elem {
  color: #f5cb65;
  font-weight: bold;
}
/* the versions: the shown one in gold, the others dim; a click opens them */
.aa-skill-elem-alt {
  font-weight: normal;
}
.aa-skill-elem-alt a {
  color: #9b9484;
}
.aa-skill-elem-alt a:hover {
  color: #f5cb65;
}
/* combo: icons, then the sentence of the game */
.aa-skill-combo {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.aa-skill-comboicons {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  flex: none;
  line-height: 0;
}
.aa-skill-comboicons img {
  display: block;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
/* (not the icons inside the hover box of the icon: ":not(.aa-skill-bufftip)") */
.aa-skill-ico-bad > img,
.aa-skill-ico-bad > :not(.aa-skill-bufftip) img {
  border-color: #d9423a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(217, 66, 58, 0.7);
}
.aa-skill-ico-good > img,
.aa-skill-ico-good > :not(.aa-skill-bufftip) img {
  border-color: #4ec24e;
  box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(78, 194, 78, 0.6);
}
.aa-skill-combotext {
  color: #9acd32;
  line-height: 1.35;
}
.aa-skill-arrow {
  color: #8a8478;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1;
}
/* chain: the skills that follow each other, the one shown is outlined */
.aa-skill-chainlabel {
  margin: 10px 0 6px;
  text-align: center;
}
.aa-skill-chainlabel span {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 1px 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: #7a1f1f;
  border: 1px solid #a33;
  color: #f3d9b0;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-skill-chain {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 4px;
  max-width: 100%;
}
.aa-skill-chain .aa-skill-arrow {
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.aa-skill-step {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  color: #a8a396;
  font-size: 11px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.aa-skill-stepicon {
  display: block;
  line-height: 0;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.aa-skill-current .aa-skill-stepicon {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ff9c27;
}
.aa-skill-current {
  color: #ff9c27;
}

/* Phones: a floated card gets its own line instead of squeezing the text */
@media (max-width: 500px) {
  .aa-skill-float {
    float: none !important;
    clear: both !important;
    margin: 0 0 0.5em 0 !important;
  }
  /* the effect box becomes a panel at the bottom of the screen (tap an icon to open) */
  .aa-skill .aa-skill-bufftip {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0.5em;
    right: 0.5em;
    top: auto;
    bottom: 0.5em;
    width: auto;
    max-height: 60vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    margin-top: 0;
  }
}

.aa-skill-orange {
  color: #ff9c27;
}

/* the item that raises the rank of the skill (Fantasia of Sorcery): a switch in the header of the card */
.aa-skill-boost {
  position: relative;
  flex: none;
  align-self: flex-start;
  margin-left: auto;
  line-height: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.aa-skill-boost img {
  display: block;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  opacity: 0.5;
  filter: grayscale(0.6);
}
.aa-skill-boost:hover img {
  opacity: 1;
  filter: none;
}
.aa-skill-boost-on img {
  opacity: 1;
  filter: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ff9c27;
}
.aa-skill-boost .aa-skill-bufftip {
  left: auto;
  right: 0;
  width: 210px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.aa-skill-boost:hover .aa-skill-bufftip {
  display: block;
}
/* the switch sits left of the versions: they keep their place at the right edge */
.aa-skill-boost + .aa-skill-tag {
  margin-left: 8px;
}
.aa-skill-boost .aa-skill-bufftip {
  left: 0;
  right: auto;
}
